brief.summary: Eclectic, intelligent layering with a quiet base and one bold idea: a plain black or navy knit with wide cream or khaki trousers, or a graphic print skirt under a chunky knit, finished with a belted coat, a long scarf and big earrings. Prints are confident and painterly (spots, florals, 60s swirls, stripes) and always grounded by black; shoes are low, pointed or sturdy.
signatures: fine black or navy knit with wide cream drawstring or paper-bag trousers
bold graphic print midi skirt under a chunky marled knit
belted trench or wool coat worn over a dress or skirt
long striped or tie-dye scarf thrown over the shoulder
shearling-trimmed coat over a printed dress and black flares
colour-block knit dress layered under a parka with wide trousers
big statement earrings and stacked bangles
crochet or striped tote, soft slouchy leather bucket bag, framed clutch
pointed kitten heels, flat pumps, chunky sandals worn with socks
palette: print accents of red, emerald and mustard
